# hookdeck_destination (Data Source)

Destination Data Source. Deprecated: renamed to `hookdeck_gateway_destination`; `hookdeck_destination` will be removed in v4.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the destination

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project to read from. With a project API key or a provider `project_id`, that project is used and this can be omitted. With an organization API key and no provider `project_id`, it is required.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Destination configuration as JSON using API version 2026-09-01.
- `created_at` (String) Date the destination was created
- `description` (String) Description for the destination
- `disabled_at` (String) Date the destination was disabled
- `name` (String) A unique, human-friendly name for the destination
- `team_id` (String) ID of the workspace
- `type` (String) Type of the destination
- `updated_at` (String) Date the destination was last updated
